mainControlKnob.function: Select process (MIG, TIG, or Stick) and navigate menu screens
mainControlKnob.pressAction: Select highlighted option or move to next screen

mig.step2: Turn to adjust Wire Feed Speed (Amperage)

tig.step2: Turn ON to energize TIG Torch

stick.step2: Turn ON to energize Electrode Holder

homeButton.function: Return to main process selection screen

backButton.function: Return to previous screen in menu navigation

steps: Press Home Button on Control Panel
Turn Main Control Knob until desired process appears on LCD display screen
Press Main Control Knob to select process

polarityAndGas.description: Cable connection and gas setup per screen

wireDiameterAndThickness.wireDiameter: Turn Left Knob to set wire diameter
wireDiameterAndThickness.materialThickness: Turn Right Knob to set material thickness

autoWeldSettings.description: Synergic system: machine auto-computes recommended amperage/voltage
autoWeldSettings.wireFeedSpeed: Turn Left Knob to adjust Wire Feed Speed (Amperage)
autoWeldSettings.voltage: Turn Right Knob to adjust Voltage
autoWeldSettings.synergicBehavior: If the Wire Feed Speed or Voltage settings are adjusted manually, the white mark on the line shows the recommended setting for your wire/electrode diameter and workpiece thickness

optionalSettings.name: Run-In WFS
optionalSettings.description: Adjust wire speed before it contacts workpiece. This setting represents a % of the pre-set wire feed speed (WFS)

optionalSettings.name: Inductance
optionalSettings.description: Adjust length of arc. Increase for more fluid puddle and flatter bead. Decrease for colder puddle

optionalSettings.name: Save Setting
optionalSettings.description: Program up to 5 different configurations. Turn Main Control Knob to scroll between 5 available slots. Press Main Control Knob to access OVERWRITE MEMORY SETTING screen and turn Main Control Knob to choose YES selection. Press Main Control Knob to save current Welder settings

steps: Press Home Button on Control Panel
Turn Main Control Knob until TIG process appears on LCD display screen
Press Main Control Knob to select TIG process

polarityAndGas.description: Cable connection and gas setup per screen

rodDiameterAndThickness.rodDiameter: Turn Left Knob to set rod diameter
rodDiameterAndThickness.materialThickness: Turn Right Knob to set material thickness

autoWeldSettings.description: Synergic system: machine auto-computes recommended amperage
autoWeldSettings.amperage: Turn Left Knob to adjust output amperage
autoWeldSettings.torchEnergize: Turn Right Knob to ON to energize TIG Torch

steps: Press Home Button on Control Panel
Turn Main Control Knob until Stick process appears on LCD display screen
Press Main Control Knob to select STICK process

polaritySettings.description: Plug cables in according to screen

electrodeType.description: Turn Main Control Knob to set electrode type

electrodeDiameterAndThickness.electrodeDiameter: Turn Left Knob to set electrode diameter
electrodeDiameterAndThickness.materialThickness: Turn Right Knob to set material thickness

autoWeldSettings.description: Synergic system: machine auto-computes recommended amperage
autoWeldSettings.amperage: Turn Left Knob to adjust output amperage
autoWeldSettings.holderEnergize: Turn Right Knob to ON to energize Electrode Holder

optionalSettings.name: Hot Start
optionalSettings.description: Adjust amperage at start of weld

synergicWeldingSystem.description: The Vulcan OmniPro 220 is a synergic welder, meaning it automatically computes recommended amperage and voltage based on wire diameter, electrode diameter, and material thickness inputs
synergicWeldingSystem.visualIndicator: A white mark on the on-screen line shows the recommended setting for your wire/electrode diameter and workpiece thickness
synergicWeldingSystem.manualAdjustment: You can manually adjust Wire Feed Speed (Amperage) and Voltage settings away from the recommended point, but the white mark remains visible as a reference
